aboutSection.title: Driving World-Class Intelligent Manufacturing
aboutSection.bodyHtml:
Guangdong TXAM Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in Shenzhen, a national science and technology center city. For 19 years, we have adhered to the corporate philosophy of "dedication, steady development, reputation first, quality first," focusing on the design and manufacturing of non-standard automated production lines.

As a long-term partner of large and medium-sized enterprises such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, Changhong, we have achieved comprehensive integrated operations in technology research and development, production, sales, and service.
